The plate is a square plate about 350 px wide. If it is a side plate of about 22 cm, that gives roughly 0.063 cm per px, or about 16 px per cm.

The photo shows 3 or 4 bacon strips that overlap. One long strip runs about 320 px, which is about 20 cm. That seems long, so the plate may be closer to 20 cm and the strip about 18 cm. Cooked bacon strips are usually about 3 cm wide and weigh about 4 g each. The strips here are thin and crispy, so the total is probably about 4 strips at roughly 4 g, or about 16 g.

Cooked crispy bacon is about 540 kcal per 100 g.
